# A03-S04: Display discussion

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]
Thanks for the text! It is really interesting and in some places so strange and funny – a bit long – what are your experiences with the audience and reading texts (the patience for it?). You should write MindFuture Foundation, MindFuture is the tech hub with our start-ups that deal with new technology – and also think the 18 global goals into the ideas, but does not as such have anything to do with art.

You must just explain to me: is it a text by an AI, which you edit or is it you who sits and writes?
I am (of course) curious about Carol Stumper – who is she – an assistant, a curator, and where does her name come from? When is Computer Lars you/human? Until he switches over to Marchel Proust?

It's a good idea to make the text for our screen in the lobby.

I can print a text for the work, which can hang next to it, if you send me one, so we include the audience from the start?

I have chased the lawyers, the contract must be just around the corner!
